title: Published Obsidian vault lives at the root domain
content:
The user’s Obsidian vault is published publicly with Quartz to GitHub Pages via the user-site repo UnixUserDev/UnixUserDev.github.io, served at the ROOT domain unixuserdev.github.io/ — not an /obsidian-vault/ subpath (that old repo name is dead and 404s). Machine-readable entry points: llms.txt / llms.json, static/contentIndex.json (with note bodies), static/contentIndex.light.json (no bodies), per-note static/notes/.json, vault-index.txt, and raw markdown via raw.githubusercontent.com/UnixUserDev/UnixUserDev.github.io/gh-pages/vault/.md. Vault convention: every note ends with Inbox so the link graph stays one connected component.
